solution.keyConcept: VBODMAS & Exact Simplification Order: Roots/Brackets -> Of -> ÷ -> × -> +/−

title.hi: विधि 1: चरणबद्ध VBODMAS / मान रखकर हल

steps.en:
1) Evaluate square/cube roots and innermost brackets ( ) first, keeping negative signs (−) intact.
2) Execute division ÷ and multiplication × left-to-right before final addition/subtraction.
3) Exact simplified result = **11.04**.
steps.hi:
1) सबसे पहले वर्गमूल/कोष्ठक ( ) हल करें और ऋणात्मक चिह्नों (− × − = +) का ध्यान रखें।
2) अंत में भाग ÷ व गुणा × के बाद जोड़-घटाव करें।
3) सटीक मान = **11.04**।

title.en: Method 2: Parallel Chunking & C9 / Sign-Check Trick (`8 sec`)

question.en: By how much is 65% of 75 greater than $\frac{3}{5}$ of 25?

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option D (**33.75**).

optionTrick.en: $65\%$ of 75 equals 48.75 (ends in `.75`) and $\frac{3}{5} \times 25 = 15$ is an exact integer — so the answer MUST preserve that exact decimal ending **.75**!
optionTrick.hi: 75 का $65\% = 48.75$ और $\frac{3}{5} \times 25 = 15$ एक पूर्णांक है — अतः अंतर के अंत में दशमलव **.75** अवश्य रहेगा!

trapAlert.en: Multiply 65 × A cleanly or split 65% = 50% + 10% + 5%; careless carry errors shift the result by 1 or 3.
trapAlert.hi: दशमलव घटाने से पहले $65\% = 50\% + 10\% + 5\%$ तोड़ने से गणना की गलती नहीं होती।

steps.en:
1) Split $65\%$ of 75 mentally: $37.5 + 7.5 + 3.75 = 48.75$.
2) Notice $\frac{3}{5}$ is $60\%$, so $\frac{3}{5} \times 25 = 15$.
3) Instant subtraction: $48.75 - 15 = \mathbf{33.75}$.

solution.en:
Method 1: Basic Step-by-Step Formula: 1) $65\%$ of $75 = \frac{65 \times 75}{100} = \frac{4875}{100} = 48.75$.
2) $\frac{3}{5}$ of $25 = 3 \times 5 = 15$.
3) Difference $= 48.75 - 15 = \mathbf{33.75}$.

Method 2: Smart 50%+10%+5% Mental Split: 1) Split $65\%$ of 75 mentally: $37.5 + 7.5 + 3.75 = 48.75$.
2) Notice $\frac{3}{5}$ is $60\%$, so $\frac{3}{5} \times 25 = 15$.
3) Instant subtraction: $48.75 - 15 = \mathbf{33.75}$.
